text_block_list.text:
The day of the Osaka Hai. Super Creek 
found herself brimming with power by 
devoting everything to her Trainer.

Just then, Tamamo Cross came by. She 
encouraged Super Creek, saying she was 
eagerly looking forward to their showdown 
at the Spring Tenno Sho.

In order to live up to her expectations, 
Super Creek headed off toward the race.
